illius, & nefariam in illum contumeliam peractam,
& falsos illos, atque iniquos locum tenen-

page.notes: Greek lines at the top are blurred; individual letters and accents are uncertain and marked [?]. A small reference mark may stand near "Synodus" and "Ignatio", but it is too faint to read, so it is not transcribed. Last word is cut off at the foot; "ces." is the catchword as far as it can be read.
